text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of six hundred thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, for public
works and permanent improvements in the Department of Mindanao and Sulu during the fiscal year ending
December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and seventeen, to be disbursed under the direction of the Secretary of
Commerce and Communications, as follows:
For the construction of trails on the islands of Mindanao and Sulu, and for cleaning navigable rivers and
For the construction and improvement of bridges on the islands of Mindanao and Sulu . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

600,000.00

In view of the peculiar conditions of a transitory character prevailing in the Department of
Mindanao and Sulu, and in order to give the government of said department the necessary facilities for
properly confronting any emergency that may arise, the administrative council of the department is hereby
authorized, subject to the approval of the Secretary of the Interior, to transfer any of the appropriations herein
before specified wholly or partially from one item to any other item herein specified.

All balances of the several appropriations made by this Act unexpended on June thirtieth,
nineteen hundred and eighteen, shall be reverted to the unappropriated funds in the Insular Treasury, and
thereafter shall not be available for withdrawal or expenditure except upon appropriation by the Legislature.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1917.
